The Health section does not replace a doctor's consultation, prescribed medication, or emergency medical care. Legal, financial, and other important decisions must likewise not be based solely on rune formulas.
Руническая магия работает не так, как эт: Runic magic does not work as portrayed in the Harry Potter books or the works of Nick Perumov. In esoteric tradition, runes are regarded as conductors of energy, but they are no panacea and cannot solve all of a person's problems for them. Their purpose is to help direct effort and circumstances toward the desired course.
Если вы сами ничего не делаете для дости: If you do nothing yourself to achieve the intended result, runes will not help you. An online tale claims that drawing ‘Fehu — Fehu — Fehu’ is enough to make money pour in. That is not so. Nothing happens without effort; money, health, and success certainly do not appear by themselves.
Сторонники рунической практики считают,: Supporters of runic practice believe that a correctly composed formula may encourage favorable circumstances and weaken unfavorable influences. Everything else, however, must be done by the person themselves.
При неумелом использовании рунических фо: Inexpert use of rune formulas can cause serious harm, especially to oneself. A simple analogy is electric current. Runes can then be compared with circuits that direct and transform energy. A correctly assembled circuit is useful. A mistake can give you a very serious shock.
Для этого необязательно обладать великим: This does not require a great gift or special abilities. An ordinary person who does not understand the principles of working with runic staves can also cause trouble. Here are several hypothetical and deliberately exaggerated examples.
Человек хочет как можно быстрее продать: Someone wants to sell a car as quickly as possible. They find a rune formula online and put it on the car without understanding its components. They may even write a statement of intent, but do so imprecisely.
Если в оговоре не указаны необходимые ус: According to esoteric beliefs, if the statement of intent omits the necessary conditions and limits, the result may follow the path of least resistance.
Машина старая и находится в плохом состо: Is the car old and in poor condition? An accident leaves it wrecked and its owner in hospital, but the car is quickly sold for scrap or parts. The wish has technically come true, yet in a completely unwanted way. The conditions therefore needed greater precision: sell the car quickly, safely, legally, at a suitable price, and without harm to the owner or others.
Маше очень понравился Петя, и она хочет,: Masha really likes Petya and wants him to notice her. Petya, however, is always busy at work and has no time for Masha. She finds a runic stave and draws it, passionately wishing for his attention.
Допустим, Петя работает врачом-травматол: Suppose Petya is a trauma doctor, and it is January with icy streets. Here is the path of least resistance: Masha falls on snow-covered ice, suffers a complex fracture, and becomes Petya's patient. He now gives her a great deal of attention, but is that the result she wanted?
Если нет, следовало точнее формулировать: If not, she needed to define the desired result, its conditions, and acceptable ways of achieving it more precisely.
Катя хочет как можно быстрее получить мн: Katya wants to obtain a lot of money as quickly as possible and become more attractive at the same time. She finds several formulas online and draws them without thinking much about possible consequences.
В тот же день рядом с ней останавливаетс: That same day, an expensive car stops beside her. A suspicious man gets out and offers a large sum for a highly questionable service. Technically, it matches the request: Katya was considered attractive, and plenty of money was offered quickly. Clearly, however, this was not the result she wanted.
Этот пример показывает, почему опасно фо: This example shows why it is dangerous to express a wish as ‘I want lots of money quickly’ without specifying safe, legal, and acceptable ways of obtaining it.
Думаю, общий посыл понятен: любые магиче: I think the general message is clear: any magical practice requires caution, an understanding of risks, and responsibility for one's decisions. According to esoteric beliefs, even protective formulas can produce an unwanted result.
Если неправильно составить оговор, форму: If the statement of intent is poorly composed, a formula could theoretically begin ‘protecting’ someone from things that pose no real danger. Aggressive protections call for particular caution: in esoteric tradition they are believed capable of affecting not only a supposed opponent, but loved ones or other people nearby.
Кот царапал хозяина — и внезапно убежал: A cat scratched its owner, then suddenly ran away or disappeared. A husband or wife was constantly irritating through words and actions, and the relationship broke down. A friend drew you into trouble, then unexpectedly stopped communicating. Such events are not necessarily connected with runes, but someone may perceive them as an unwanted result of an overly broad or aggressive statement of intent.
Cleansing also calls for moderation. In esoteric circles, excessive or incorrect use of cleansing formulas is believed capable of draining a person emotionally and energetically instead of strengthening them.
Не используйте руны во вред другим: Do not use runes to harm others
И самое главное: ни в коем случае не исп: Above all, never use runes maliciously or try to harm another person with them.
В эзотерических традициях считается, что: Esoteric traditions hold that a directed influence may encounter resistance or return to its sender. The intended recipient may have their own protections, religious beliefs, support from loved ones, or help from another practitioner. They may also be psychologically and energetically more resilient than you.
Допустим, вы решили «проучить» соседа и: Suppose you decide to ‘teach a neighbor a lesson’ and compose a harmful formula against them. Their relatives may be praying for them; they may have helped a priest who mentioned them during a service, established their own protection, or consulted another practitioner. Your attempt may simply have no effect. It can nevertheless lead to conflict, anxiety, guilt, and other unpleasant consequences for you.
